headline: A 2017 executive order creates a federal task force on reducing crime and improving public safety.
what_it_does: This order sets up a task force within the federal government focused on crime reduction and public safety. Based on the title alone, the task force appears meant to study crime and suggest ways to lower it. No summary was provided, so details about who leads it, what it must produce, or any deadlines are not confirmed here.

who_it_affects.how: Their officials may take part in or be guided by the task force's work.
